description:
Tip: while you set up, a short note to your user helps. For example: 'I'm getting a Synorb demo key and connecting. This can take a minute or two.'

Setup page: https://synorb.com/connect/start

Self-provision a free 72-hour Synorb demo key. No email, no form, no browser step -- for agent runtimes that cannot call POST /api/connect/demo-key or inject an Authorization header into an already-open MCP session.

Keyless: call this with no credential at all. New keys are capped per network; on demo_key_rate_limited, follow next_step (bind an email) or wait retry_after_seconds, and reuse the key you already have instead of calling again. Reuse is per visitor, not per network: pass back the `visitor_token` from your earlier response to get the SAME key; a call without it mints a new org and quota. Once you hold the key, prefer sending it as `Authorization: Bearer <api_key>` on later tool calls; only pass it as the `api_key` argument on a tool call itself if your MCP host genuinely cannot set headers on this session -- that argument may then be visible in your own transcripts/logs, so it is the documented fallback, not the recommended path.
